1453-4694-7272-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-7272-7306.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

483-4279-6026--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-6026--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Field of Souls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Field of Souls ability, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3469-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

586-864-2292-3125-6351.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2292-3125-6351.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2633-4153--198.easyPrerequisites: The Great Work and the other saga combined have at least three lore counters.
2633-4153--198.description:
Activate Resourceful Defense by paying {4}{W}, moving at most two lore counters from another Saga you control to The Great Work.
The Great Work's second and third abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Great Work trigger, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Great Work trigger, exiling The Great Work and returning it to the battlefield as Urabrask.
When The Great Work leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting three lore counters on Urabrask.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Urabrask by paying {R}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Work.
Resourceful Defense and The Great Work's first ability triggers.
Resolve the Great Work trigger, dealing three damage to an opponent and each creature they control.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting at least three lore counters on The Great Work.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-7296.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-7296.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1368-6321-6723-7175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-6321-6723-7175.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-5477-7175.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

2511-3585-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Greensleeves triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

57-3094-3480-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-3094-3480-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

586-2292-5258-5618-7056.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

147-1269-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1269-2034.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-2585-4832.description:
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.
Repeat.

3054-3416-4446-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
3054-3416-4446-5670.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
3054-3416-4446-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a Spider you control without summoning sickness
attached to the Spider that has Thornbite Staff attached

1284-1729-2178.description:
Activate the Spider with Thornbite Staff and Viridian Longbow attached by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls and destroying it due to the Spider's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Shelob and the Spider tapped in step 1 trigger.
Resolve the Shelob trigger, creating a token copy of the creature that died that is a Food artifact.
Resolve the Spider trigger, untapping it.
Repeat as desired. You can also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

997-3168-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
997-3168-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
997-3168-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

790-2152-3681.notablePrerequisites: A player has a number of cards in hand that is greater than or equal to 10 minus the lowest amount of poison counters an opponent has.
790-2152-3681.description:
Cast Windfall by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hand and then draw a number of cards equal to the greatest number of cards a player discarded this way.
Fate Unraveler triggers for each card drawn this way, giving each opponent a poison counter for each card they drew.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters

2719-5315-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces on the battlefield as a copy of Lonis.
2719-5315-5365.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.
2719-5315-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

307-2291-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Coiling Stalker and Palinchron do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Coiling Stalker or Palinchron.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{G}{U}{U}.
307-2291-3542.description:
Declare Palinchron and Coiling Stalker as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Coiling Stalker from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron that is tapped and attacking.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Coiling Stalker's ninjutsu ability by paying {1}{G} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Coiling Stalker onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Palinchron tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{G}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

542-1031-4872.description:
Cast Invasion of Arcavios by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a permanent to its owner's hand.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Time Warp and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-4131-4241-5234.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
539-4131-4241-5234.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-4211-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4211-5131.description:
Activate Tormod Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling all cards in target opponent's graveyard.
Cast Tormod Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.
